# Januario Pinto

> Software developer and consultant in Porto. Designs and consults companies as living systems and creates software. Founder of The Unit Organization, an incubator and studio.

## Services
- Software development: web platforms, internal tools, AI features and automation. A working product, not a prototype.
- Consulting: strategy, technology and organization. Fractional CTO without the cost of a full-time hire. Distributed systems that don't rely on the founder. Self-managing teams (Teal, Holacracy).
- Ventures: companies built from the ground up, incubated and funded through The Unit Organization.

## Public portfolio
- People: the CRM for clients and patients, in one place.
- Flows: build the chat bots a business runs on, step by step.
- Artist OS: site, bookings and numbers for artists.
- And more in the works. Open to investors and buyers: contact@januariopinto.com

## What I'm doing now
- Automating systems for restaurants, shops and services.
- Creating harnesses for doctors, clinics and teams.
- Building software factories.
- Working with private clients.
